decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (0036/03 and 04, Planning Statement, received on 31/01/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times: 08:00-20:00 Monday- Sundays.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for retail, exhibition hall, art gallery and ancillary training in relation to antiques and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - Amplified noise created within the premises shall not be audible outside the premises.
Condition : 6 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The rating level of any noise generated as part of the use shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level as determined by BS4142: 1997- "Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".
description: Change of use of the premises to retail (Use Class A1) use for the sale of antiques with ancillary related exhibitions, meetings, functions and ancillary education and training in relation to antiques.
